notes.title: Apartment 327 Patch Note 1.2
notes.content:
Thanks to all the Apartment 327 players for giving us valuable feedback. We publish new update with numerous improvements:
[list]
[*] Reduction of the load times of the game.
[*] Improvements in the breathing audios.
[*] Fixed the failure of the doors in the pause menus of the movies.
[*] Improvements in the piano puzzle for Chinese and Russian players.
[*] [spoiler]Fixed the bug that blocked the secret end for some players.[/spoiler]
[*] Improvements in the enemy AI.
[*] Inclusion of new visual indicators to improve user interaction.
[*] Graphic corrections.
[*] Correction of minor errors.
[*] Improvements in optimization.
[/list]

notes.title: Apartment 327 Patch Note 1.1
notes.content:
Thank you to all the Apartment 327 players for giving us this great feedback during the weekend. We publish an update version of the game  with numerous improvements:

- Improvements in the enemy AI.
- New visual indicators to improve user interaction in some puzzles.
-  Y axis inversion. Temporary with Key 1 or numpad 1.
- Graphic corrections
- Correction of minor errors.
- Improvements in optimization.

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE Patch Note [1.2]
notes.content:
Thanks to the more than 2000 gamers around the world that played the demo. Thanks to all the feedback you have sent us we are glad to update the demo version with new features and some minor bugs fixed.

[list]
[*] Removed all SteamVR references
[*] Now you can skip the introduction screen
[*] Newspaper HUD bug fixed
[*] Translations
[*] Better performance.
[/list]

More updates coming soon. Stay tuned!

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE Patch Note [1.1]
notes.content:
Thanks to the more than 1000 gamers around the world that played the demo during the weekend, and with all the feedback they have sent us we are glad to update the demo version with new features and some minor bugs fixed.
[list]
[*] Now the flash light will return to the player automatically after the asylum part.
[*] Character movement improvements.
[*] Added some extra sounds
[*] Fixed the HUD for playing in 4:3 screens
[*] Translations 
[*] Better performance.
[/list]

More updates coming soon. Stay tuned!
